_help: One entry per animated scene. 'scene' must match a function in assets/js/scenes.js (SCENES.<name>). Fig. numbers are automatic, in page order. Where each figure sits on the page is set in src/template.html with {{fig:<key>}}. 'alt' is read by screen readers and search engines, so describe what happens in one sentence.

hero.alt: A boy throws a ball and his yellow Labrador fetches it
hero.caption: The Labrador returns whatever the author throws.

edu.alt: A boy at a board where a mixed signal splits into two sources, with his dog asleep beside him
edu.caption: A mixed signal on the left, two separated sources on the right.

exp.alt: A boy walks along server racks with his dog while a load meter climbs from 1x to 6x
exp.caption: Walking the racks while load grows from 1x to 6x (schematic).

uav.alt: A drone flies over a field and polls three sensor nodes while a boy and his dog watch
uav.caption: A UAV visiting sensor nodes in a field (in progress).

skills.alt: A boy types at a laptop while a commit moves along a conveyor through build, test and deploy, and a cluster of pods scales out
skills.caption: A change moves through build, test and deploy while the cluster scales out (schematic).

contact.alt: A phone rings, the dog barks, and the boy runs over to answer
contact.caption: The phone rings, the dog barks, the author answers.
